/** 
 * Returns a  {@link Codec} for video decoding.
 * @param format The {@link Format} (of the input data) used to determine the underlying {@link MediaCodec} and its configuration values.
 * @param outputSurface The {@link Surface} to which the decoder output is rendered.
 * @return A configured and started decoder wrapper.
 * @throws TransformationException If the underlying codec cannot be created.
 */
Codec createForVideoDecoding(Format format,Surface outputSurface) throws TransformationException ;
